title: Presentation of Financial Statements
summary: Overall requirements for presentation of financial statements, including structure, content, and general features. NAS 1 is aligned with IAS 1.

title: Inventories
summary: Cost measurement and NRV write-down of inventories. NAS 2 is aligned with IAS 2.

title: Statement of Cash Flows
summary: Requirements for presentation of a statement of cash flows classified by operating, investing, and financing activities. NAS 7 is aligned with IAS 7.

title: Accounting Policies, Changes in Accounting Estimates and Errors
summary: Criteria for selecting and changing accounting policies, accounting for changes in estimates, and correcting prior-period errors. NAS 8 is aligned with IAS 8.

title: Events After the Reporting Period
summary: When to adjust financial statements for events after the reporting period and required disclosures. NAS 10 is aligned with IAS 10.

title: Income Taxes
summary: Current and deferred tax accounting. NAS 12 is aligned with IAS 12.

title: Property, Plant and Equipment
summary: Recognition, measurement, and depreciation of property, plant and equipment. NAS 16 is aligned with IAS 16.

title: Employee Benefits
summary: Accounting for all forms of employee benefits including short-term, post-employment, and termination benefits. NAS 19 is aligned with IAS 19.

title: Accounting for Government Grants and Disclosure of Government Assistance
summary: Accounting for and disclosure of government grants and other forms of government assistance. NAS 20 is aligned with IAS 20.

title: The Effects of Changes in Foreign Exchange Rates
summary: How to include foreign currency transactions and foreign operations in financial statements and translate into a presentation currency. NAS 21 is aligned with IAS 21.

title: Borrowing Costs
summary: Borrowing costs directly attributable to qualifying assets must be capitalised. All other borrowing costs are expensed. NAS 23 is aligned with IAS 23.

title: Related Party Disclosures
summary: Ensures financial statements contain disclosures to draw attention to related party relationships and transactions. NAS 24 is aligned with IAS 24.

title: Accounting and Reporting by Retirement Benefit Plans
summary: Financial reporting by retirement benefit plans, covering both defined contribution and defined benefit plans. NAS 26 is aligned with IAS 26.

title: Separate Financial Statements
summary: Accounting and disclosure requirements when a parent prepares separate (non-consolidated) financial statements. NAS 27 is aligned with IAS 27.

title: Investments in Associates and Joint Ventures
summary: Application of the equity method for investments in associates and joint ventures. NAS 28 is aligned with IAS 28.

title: Financial Reporting in Hyperinflationary Economies
summary: Financial reporting requirements when an entity's functional currency is that of a hyperinflationary economy. Not currently applicable in Nepal. NAS 29 is aligned with IAS 29.

title: Financial Instruments: Presentation
summary: Principles for presenting financial instruments as liabilities or equity and for offsetting financial assets and liabilities. NAS 32 is aligned with IAS 32.

title: Earnings Per Share
summary: Principles for determining and presenting earnings per share to improve comparability. NAS 33 is aligned with IAS 33.

title: Interim Financial Reporting
summary: Minimum content for interim financial reports and recognition and measurement principles for interim periods. NAS 34 is aligned with IAS 34.

title: Impairment of Assets
summary: Testing and recognising impairment losses on assets. NAS 36 is aligned with IAS 36.

title: Provisions, Contingent Liabilities and Contingent Assets
summary: Recognition, measurement, and disclosure of provisions, contingent liabilities, and contingent assets. NAS 37 is aligned with IAS 37.

title: Intangible Assets
summary: Recognition, measurement, and disclosure of intangible assets not covered by other standards. NAS 38 is aligned with IAS 38.

title: Financial Instruments: Recognition and Measurement
summary: Recognition and measurement of financial instruments — largely superseded by NFRS 9 but still applicable for certain hedge accounting provisions. NAS 39 is aligned with IAS 39.

title: Investment Property
summary: Recognition, measurement, and disclosure of investment property held to earn rental income or for capital appreciation. NAS 40 is aligned with IAS 40.

title: Agriculture
summary: Accounting for biological assets and agricultural produce at the point of harvest. NAS 41 is aligned with IAS 41.

title: First-time Adoption of Nepal Financial Reporting Standards
summary: Framework for entities adopting NFRS for the first time — opening balance sheet, mandatory exceptions, and optional exemptions. NFRS 1 is aligned with IFRS 1.

title: Share-based Payment
summary: Recognition and measurement of share-based payment transactions including employee stock options. NFRS 2 is aligned with IFRS 2.

title: Business Combinations
summary: Acquisition method for business combinations — recognising and measuring goodwill and identifiable assets and liabilities. NFRS 3 is aligned with IFRS 3.

title: Insurance Contracts
summary: Interim standard for insurance contracts — largely superseded by NFRS 17 but still applied by entities that have not yet adopted NFRS 17. NFRS 4 is aligned with IFRS 4.

title: Non-current Assets Held for Sale and Discontinued Operations
summary: Measurement of non-current assets held for sale and presentation of discontinued operations. NFRS 5 is aligned with IFRS 5.

title: Exploration for and Evaluation of Mineral Resources
summary: Financial reporting for exploration and evaluation expenditures for mineral resources. NFRS 6 is aligned with IFRS 6.

title: Financial Instruments: Disclosures
summary: Disclosure requirements enabling users to evaluate the significance of financial instruments and the nature and extent of risks. NFRS 7 is aligned with IFRS 7.

title: Operating Segments
summary: Disclosure of information about operating segments, products, geographical areas, and major customers. NFRS 8 is aligned with IFRS 8.

title: Financial Instruments
carveOuts: Effective interest rate method deferred for certain entities
Expected credit loss model — simplified approach permitted for banks until 2025
summary: Classification, measurement, impairment, and hedge accounting for financial instruments. NFRS 9 has notable carve-outs from IFRS 9 including ECL deferrals.

title: Consolidated Financial Statements
summary: Requirements for the preparation and presentation of consolidated financial statements based on the control model. NFRS 10 is aligned with IFRS 10.

title: Joint Arrangements
summary: Classification and accounting for joint arrangements — distinguishing joint operations from joint ventures. NFRS 11 is aligned with IFRS 11.

title: Disclosure of Interests in Other Entities
summary: Disclosure requirements for interests in subsidiaries, joint arrangements, associates, and unconsolidated structured entities. NFRS 12 is aligned with IFRS 12.

title: Fair Value Measurement
summary: Single framework for measuring fair value and required disclosures — defines the three-level fair value hierarchy. NFRS 13 is aligned with IFRS 13.

title: Regulatory Deferral Accounts
summary: Permits first-time adopters with rate-regulated activities to continue recognising regulatory deferral account balances. NFRS 14 is aligned with IFRS 14.

title: Revenue from Contracts with Customers
summary: Five-step model for revenue recognition. NFRS 15 is aligned with IFRS 15 with no material carve-outs.

title: Leases
summary: Single lessee accounting model requiring right-of-use assets. NFRS 16 is aligned with IFRS 16.

title: Insurance Contracts
carveOuts: Effective date deferred from 16 July 2023 to 16 July 2024 by ASB Nepal
summary: Measurement and presentation of insurance contracts. NFRS 17 effective date was deferred by ASB Nepal.
